$comment: Committed, shared project settings. Until now .claude/ held only a
settings.local.json that this machine's global gitignore excludes, so
nothing here was versioned or shared.
Scope is deliberately narrow: this repo's own deterministic, read-only
checkers and test suites, so a session can run the gates without a
prompt for each one. It does not carry the broad wildcards the local
file accumulated (git push, gh api, bare python) -- those are a
convenience for one machine, not a property of the project, and an
allowlist that permits everything documents nothing.
Two entries in the local file name scripts that do not exist:
verify_llms_docs.py, deleted as an RCE vector, and
test_check_session_log.py, which lives only on the parked branch.
Neither is carried over.
The ast-grep allow entries below remain load-bearing for Stage-0 and
citation workflows. Text search (Grep tool / rg / grep) is ALLOWED as of
2026-08-09 — prefer ast-grep for structural code citations, but inventory
and prose may use ripgrep. deny_text_search.py is a no-op allow; it stays
wired so tokenizer helpers remain importable by deny_raw_network.
check_repo_claims.py check F still requires a scoped Bash(ast-grep…)
allow entry when agents declare Bash, and still requires network denies.
The semgrep entries are the same pattern for software-architect-and-
testing, which also declares bare Bash. It runs
scripts/coverage/spring_semgrep_rules.yml plus, occasionally, a community
registry config -- 'semgrep scan:*' covers both without unscoped Bash.
The curl/wget/git-clone denies below are the network-egress gate:
software-architect-and-testing is the only agent granted both Bash and
WebFetch today; raw shell must not reach arXiv/GitHub/deepwiki.com.
git clone is denied by subcommand, not bare git. check F fails the build
if a Bash-granted agent is missing these three network denies.
doc-engine query / query_artifacts entries are read-only Stage-0 artifact
lookups (capped typed views). Prefer them over Read-ing whole
spring_signals.json when a run dir exists — see adapters/claude/SEARCH.md.
E-RES0 (2026-08-09): design-shaped commits require research Spec memo
with arXiv + GitHub evidence (docs/research/14). Separate from
require_hardened_tests — different failure class (research theater vs
missing sibling tests).
Added 2026-07-25 after this exact mistake produced two false 'green'
reports in one session: `gradle ... | tail -30` then `echo "EXIT=$?"`
reads tail's exit code, not gradle's -- tail always exits 0. Runs on
every Bash call (cheap regex over the command string); denies with a
corrective pattern rather than asking, since a human is not always
present to unblock a background session. See .claude/hooks/
check_pipe_exit_code.py for the full reasoning and its escape hatches
(PIPESTATUS, pipefail).
A second hook (enforce_repo_claims_before_commit.py) was written
alongside this one to run check_repo_claims.py before every git
commit, then deleted on discovering hooks/require_hardened_tests.py
already does that plus check_code_quality.py plus missing-test-sibling
and unwired-CI-suite checks. Do not re-add it -- extend
require_hardened_tests.py instead if this gate needs to grow.
